description: Defines the RocketCvarInlineElement class, a custom UI element for handling console variables (cvars) with dynamic updates and formatting in the Unvanquished game engine.

classes.name: RocketCvarInlineElement
classes.description: A custom UI element class for displaying and updating cvar values with formatting and special flags.

methods.name: OnAttributeChange
methods.description: Handles changes to element attributes, updating internal state accordingly.

methods.name: OnUpdate
methods.description: Updates the displayed value based on cvar state, formatting, and attributes.
